title: Chinese-Style Irish Rice Bowl
description: A fusion of Chinese flavors with the hearty goodness of Irish rice. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the ginger and garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the scallions and cook for another minute.
Add the Irish rice and biriyani, stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, salt, and pepper, stir-fry for another minute.
Transfer the mixture to a serving bowl, garnish with scallions.
Cook the chewy according to package instructions.
Serve the cooked chewy on the side, or mix it with the rice mixture before serving.
